Two red repair areas occur only on the same front-view left roof slope at the front and rear ends.
Small cupola W8 rectangular side glazing and W9 V-bottom glazing remain visible above intersecting roof; 6 cm clearance shift is disclosed.

Rear high arched window tracery, opaque lower windows and side door/window arrangements remain distinct.
